jobs.title: 2027 Bioinformatics Scientist Summer Intern
jobs.content: <p><strong>Summer 2027 Internship</strong></p><p>Join our biomedical data science team working on bioinformatics and drug-development data. You will use Python, R/Bioconductor and SQL on high-performance computing infrastructure.</p><ul><li>Applicants must be currently enrolled in a Master&#39;s or PhD program in bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related quantitative field.</li><li>A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 is required.</li><li>Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not provide visa sponsorship for internships.</li><li>Hourly rate: $32.00 - $41.00 per hour depending on degree level.</li><li>12 weeks, May 2027 through August 2027, on-site in Columbus.</li></ul><p>Application requires a resume and an unofficial transcript. Selected candidates complete a recorded video interview.</p>
